description: Claim-support golden set (Phase 9). Each pair is a REAL quote from the offline corpus and a claim. expected: supported | partial | not_supported. Measures the Claim Support Judge used by validate_citation and the Critic. Includes 'real quote, stretched claim' cases, which quote verification alone can never catch.

pairs.quote: Across the deployments we studied, keeping a self-hosted model reliable in production required between 0.25 and 0.5 of a full-time engineer on an ongoing basis: patching drivers and serving software, handling capacity, monitoring quality, and upgrading models.
pairs.claim: Running a self-hosted model in production took 0.25 to 0.5 of a full-time engineer in the studied deployments.

pairs.quote: For small teams, labour dominates the comparison.
pairs.claim: For every company, engineering labour is the largest cost of running an LLM.

pairs.quote: Below that threshold, hosted APIs had the lower TCO in every scenario we modelled.
pairs.claim: Self-hosting is always cheaper than hosted APIs.

pairs.quote: Across the major providers we surveyed, small and mid-sized models are now priced between $0.10 and $0.60 per million input tokens, while frontier models range from $2 to $15 per million input tokens.
pairs.claim: Small and mid-sized hosted models cost between $0.10 and $0.60 per million input tokens.

pairs.quote: In our sample of twelve startups with fewer than ten employees, the median team processed about 40 million tokens per month.
pairs.claim: Startups typically process about 400 million tokens per month.

pairs.quote: Providers also offer volume discounts and batch pricing, which can reduce costs by 30 to 50 percent for workloads that do not need real-time answers.
pairs.claim: Batch pricing cuts API costs by 30 to 50 percent for every workload.

pairs.quote: For short prompts, the dedicated deployment had a median time-to-first-token of about 120 milliseconds, compared with 250 to 600 milliseconds for the shared APIs.
pairs.claim: For short prompts, a dedicated GPU deployment had a lower median time-to-first-token than shared APIs.

pairs.quote: The dedicated GPU has its own ceiling: once concurrent requests exceeded its capacity, latency rose sharply, and adding capacity meant provisioning another GPU.
pairs.claim: A dedicated GPU keeps latency low at any number of concurrent requests.

pairs.quote: Many retain prompts and outputs for a limited period, commonly up to 30 days, to detect abuse, after which the data is deleted.
pairs.claim: Many API providers keep prompts for up to 30 days to detect abuse.

pairs.quote: Self-hosting does not remove these obligations.
pairs.claim: Self-hosting an LLM removes a bank's compliance obligations for customer financial data.

pairs.quote: Up to about 10 million vectors, query latency stayed under 20 milliseconds at 95 percent recall on a single mid-sized database server.
pairs.claim: pgvector keeps query latency under 20 milliseconds at any scale.

pairs.quote: Exposed inference endpoints without authentication have been found on the public internet, allowing anyone to use or abuse the model.
pairs.claim: Unauthenticated self-hosted inference endpoints have been found exposed on the public internet.
